why: The phone as each variant run has it (WORKLIST P0.86): each name's adb shell commands set before the run touches the phone and put back once it ends, so nothing outlives its run. Where the phone's own value is not a fixed default, `read` takes it first (the last word of its answer, which must match `answer`) and a reset's {was} puts it back. `ready`, for a setting the system takes a while to apply, is asked until it answers yes (exit 0). `flows`: the run takes every flow before the route walk, on three machines; every other variant walks the routes alone, on one. run-flows.sh runs them (e2e/variants.mjs); variants.test.ts holds every one to a setup, a reset and a reason.

plain.why: The phone as every run has it: the walk's captures every other variant is read against.

motion-on.why: Android's transitions and animations at 1, as most members have them: every other run has them at 0, which React Native and Reanimated read as Reduce Motion. The window animation stays 0, because one holds injected keys.

largest-text.why: The largest text Android offers a member (font scale 2).

bold-text.why: Bold text, as Android's accessibility setting gives it.

narrowest.why: The narrowest width a member's phone can be, under 320 dp: the emulator's 1080 px at density 560 is 308 dp.

three-button.why: Android's three-button navigation bar, taller than the gesture bar every other run has.

right-to-left.why: The phone in Arabic (Iraq), as a member who reads Arabic has it: Android lays every app out right to left. The language is the system's own, set as root with the system restarted, and the language the phone had is put back the same way.

light.why: The system in light mode: the app keeps its own grounds, and what the system draws over it (an alert, the keyboard, the date picker) must still read. The mode the phone had is read first and put back.
